title: Tiny, cute hot air balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='balloonGrad' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='65%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb3c6'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e63946'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- balloon envelope -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='25' ry='28' fill='url(#balloonGrad)'/>
  <!-- lighter highlight stripe -->
  <path d='M50 8 Q33 20 33 36 Q33 52 50 64 Q67 52 67 36 Q67 20 50 8 Z' fill='#ffd166' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- vertical gores for dimension -->
  <path d='M38 10 Q34 24 34 36 Q34 50 40 62' fill='none' stroke='#c1121f' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M62 10 Q66 24 66 36 Q66 50 60 62' fill='none' stroke='#c1121f' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- basket ropes -->
  <line x1='40' y1='62' x2='44' y2='74' stroke='#b5651d' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='60' y1='62' x2='56' y2='74' stroke='#b5651d' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- basket -->
  <rect x='43' y='73' width='14' height='11' rx='2' fill='#c08552'/>
  <rect x='43' y='73' width='14' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#e0a96d'/>
  <line x1='46' y1='76' x2='46' y2='84' stroke='#8a5a2b' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='76' x2='50' y2='84' stroke='#8a5a2b' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='76' x2='54' y2='84' stroke='#8a5a2b' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- tiny flame glow above basket -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='2.5' ry='3' fill='#ffe066'/>
</svg>
